# Stage 0.5: BOS 鉴权下载全部 Stage 2 wheels 到 wheels/
# 失败即 exit 1，禁止走 tuna / pypi.org fallback
# ============================================================
if [ ${ABORT} -eq 0 ]; then
S05_LOG="${REPORT_DIR}/stage0_5.log"
(
set -e
log "=== Stage 0.5: BOS pull all Stage 2 wheels (bcecmd --conf-path) ==="
mkdir -p "${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels"

# bcecmd 真实配置目录（避开评测机 ~ 可能不一致）：显式 --conf-path
# 格式 [Defaults] + 大写 Ak/Sk + 两个文件 credentials + config
mkdir -p "${BCE_CONF}"
cat > "${BCE_CONF}/credentials" <<CRED
[Defaults]
Ak = ${BOS_AK}
Sk = ${BOS_SK}
CRED
cat > "${BCE_CONF}/config" <<'CFG'
[Defaults]
Domain = bj.bcebos.com
Region = bj
AutoSwitchDomain = yes
Https = yes
UsePathStyle = no
CFG

chmod +x "${BCECMD}"
echo "bcecmd version:"
"${BCECMD}" --version 2>&1 | head -2

BCE="${BCECMD} --conf-path ${BCE_CONF}"
echo "--- BOS ls ${BOS_PREFIX}/ ---"
${BCE} bos ls "${BOS_PREFIX}/" 2>&1 | head -3

echo "--- BOS cp -r ${BOS_PREFIX}/ -> ${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels/ ---"
t0=$(date +%s)
${BCE} bos cp -r "${BOS_PREFIX}/" "${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels/" 2>&1 | tail -5
t1=$(date +%s)
echo "BOS download elapsed: $((t1 - t0))s"

echo "--- local wheels after pull ---"
whl_count=$(ls "${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels/"*.whl 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
whl_size=$(du -sh "${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels/" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "wheel count=${whl_count}  total=${whl_size}"

# 关键 whl 必须在（runtime 核心 + cu13 RPATH 依赖 + 量化）
for p in torch torchvision torchaudio \
         nvidia_cudnn_cu13 nvidia_nccl_cu13 nvidia_cusparselt_cu13 \
         nvidia_nvshmem_cu13 nvidia_cublas nvidia_cuda_runtime \
         nvidia_cuda_nvrtc nvidia_cufft nvidia_cusolver nvidia_cusparse \
         nvidia_nvjitlink nvidia_nvtx \
         triton flashinfer_python flashinfer_cubin \
         nvidia_modelopt llmcompressor compressed_tensors accelerate \
         fastapi uvicorn orjson msgspec pyzmq transformers; do
    if ! ls "${SCRIPT_DIR}/wheels/${p}"*.whl 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[FATAL] missing wheel: ${p}"; exit 1
    fi
done
echo "all ${whl_count} wheels present, size=${whl_size}"
) > "${S05_LOG}" 2>&1
S05_STATUS=$?
send_stage "0.5" "bos-download-wheels" "${S05_LOG}" ${S05_STATUS}
[ ${S05_STATUS} -ne 0 ] && die "0.5 bos-download-wheels" "${S05_LOG}"
fi  # end Stage 0.5 guard

# ============================================================
# Stage 1: apt — purge cu12, install cu13

 echo "[prepare_env] cuDNN upgraded: $(python3 -c 'import cudnn; print(f"backend={cudnn.backend_version()} frontend={cudnn.__version__}")')"

+# 2.2 Upgrade FlashInfer (cu13 extras, GDC flag in source, no sed patch needed)
+uv pip install "flashinfer-python[cu13]>=0.6.8.post1" "flashinfer-cubin>=0.6.8.post1"
 echo "[prepare_env] FlashInfer upgraded: $(python3 -c 'import flashinfer; print(flashinfer.__version__)')"
 # Clear entire JIT cache — new version must rebuild all kernels
 rm -rf ~/.cache/flashinfer/
@@ -34,19 +34,8 @@ cp "$INSTALLED_SO" "${INSTALLED_SO}.bak"
 cp "${SCRIPT_DIR}/common_ops.abi3.so" "$INSTALLED_SO"
 echo "[prepare_env] replaced common_ops.abi3.so ($(stat -c%s "${SCRIPT_DIR}/common_ops.abi3.so") bytes)"
 
-# 5. Fix FlashInfer CUTLASS FP4 GEMM PDL race on SM120.
-#    The stock FlashInfer 0.5.3 JIT recipe for fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120 misses
-#    the GDC flag, which can produce NaNs on long-context chunked prefill in a
-#    cold environment. Patch the JIT recipe before server startup and clear the
-#    cached op so the kernel is rebuilt with the correct flag.
-FLASHINFER_GEMM_CORE=[REDACTED]
-if grep -q 'fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120' "$FLASHINFER_GEMM_CORE" && ! grep -q 'CUTLASS_ENABLE_GDC_FOR_SM100' "$FLASHINFER_GEMM_CORE"; then
-    sed -i '/"fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120"/,/extra_cflags/{
-        s/"-DENABLE_FP4",/"-DENABLE_FP4",\n            "-DCUTLASS_ENABLE_GDC_FOR_SM100=1",/
-    }' "$FLASHINFER_GEMM_CORE"
-    rm -rf ~/.cache/flashinfer/*/120a/cached_ops/fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120/
-    echo "[prepare_env] patched FlashInfer SM120 FP4 GEMM with GDC flag, cleared JIT cache"
-fi
+# 5. FlashInfer 0.6.8.post1+ already includes CUTLASS_ENABLE_GDC_FOR_SM100 in source
+#    for fp4_gemm_cutlass_sm120 — sed patch no longer required.
 
 # 5.1 Pre-build the FlashInfer SM120 FP4 GEMM JIT op so the eval server does
 #     not have to compile it on first use. This makes the cold-start platform
@@ -62,11 +51,13 @@ DTN=$((1 + TOPK * SPEC_STEPS))
 EAGLE_DRAFT="${SCRIPT_DIR}/data/eagle_draft"
 export SGLANG_SERVER_ARGS="--disable-radix-cache --attention-backend minicpm_flashinfer --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --skip-server-warmup --dense-as-sparse --quantization modelopt_fp4 --max-running-requests 64 --mem-fraction-static 0.75 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 --speculative-num-steps ${SPEC_STEPS} --speculative-eagle-topk ${TOPK} --speculative-num-draft-tokens ${DTN} --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer --speculative-draft-model-path ${EAGLE_DRAFT}"
 export SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48
